opening.argument: The presentation directs viewers to deploy a smart contract, connect a wallet, pay a transaction fee, and fund the flash-loan workflow with 5 BNB, while promising that volatile price differences will produce huge profits. The speaker then reports roughly 0.3 BNB earned in about an hour and characterizes the opportunity as passive income. Those instructions connect cryptocurrency funding and fee payment directly to substantial-return claims, rather than merely describing a theoretical tool. Although the speaker says the bot is free and not intended for profit, that qualification does not remove the practical funding and deployment steps or the reported earnings used to encourage participation.
